components.html:
Marci Metzger

Realtor for nearly 3 decades

Pahrump Realtor · The Ridge Realty Group

narrative.overview:
The category standard played straight, at luxury-brokerage craft. The page is light and calm: a white ground, a warm stone tint for working sections, and the Pahrump Valley's own photography carrying the mood. The brand is The Ridge Realty Group's navy and gold, taken from the brokerage logo, and Marci's name is set in a Didone the way a brokerage sets a nameplate.

Restraint does the work. Square corners, 1px hairlines, underline-style form fields and generous section spacing replace ornament. Gold appears only as thin rules and small marks, never as a fill or as text on white. Navy is used for brand bands (services, footer) and primary buttons, so the page stays light overall. Motion is limited to one entrance on load.

The user rejected themed or costume worlds and heavy dark grounds as not elegant. This system is the replacement: clean, elegant and photo-led.
keyCharacteristics: White and warm-stone grounds; navy reserved for brand bands and primary actions.
Gold as hairline only: rules, link underlines, the hero rule, nav underlines.
Bodoni Moda at weight 400 for every display and heading role; Archivo at normal width for all text and labels.
Square corners everywhere; 1px hairlines; underline-only form fields.
One full-bleed photograph (the hero); every other image sits inside the container.
One authored motion: the gold rule draws in and the hero text rises once.

rules.name: The Hairline Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is for hairlines, rules and small marks only. Never set text in gold on white, and never use gold as a fill.

rules.name: The Logo Palette Rule
rules.body: The brand hues are the navy and gold from The Ridge Realty Group's logo. Do not add a third brand hue. The only extra color is a small functional green chip for the "open now" office status.

rules.name: The Light Ground Rule
rules.body: The page is white and stone. Navy fills bounded brand bands (services, footer) and buttons. It is never the overall page ground.

rules.name: The Didone Voice Rule
rules.body: Bodoni Moda is for names, headings, the lede and serif sub-lines, always at weight 400. It never sets labels, buttons or small text. Archivo stays at normal width; do not use its width axis.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow or kicker label sits above a heading. Spaced capitals belong to buttons, nav, form labels, captions and the hero firm line, which sits below the name.

rules.name: The One Full-Bleed Rule
rules.body: The hero is the only full-bleed photograph. Gallery sources are only 1024px wide, so every other image stays inside the container at 1024px or smaller.

rules.name: The No Metric Row Rule
rules.body: Proof is stated in sentences (the lede), never as a row of stats or metric tiles.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. A shadow appears only beneath a surface that floats over other content, and it is always soft and navy-tinted. No hard or offset shadows.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: Nothing is rounded. Form comes from 1px lines and white space.

rules.name: The Focus Ground Rule
rules.body: The focus ring is a 2px solid navy outline at 3px offset on light grounds, and soft gold on navy bands and on the hero.

rules.name: The Single Entrance Rule
rules.body: There is one authored motion. On load, the hero gold rule draws in from the left (scaleX, 1.2s after a 0.2s delay), and the name, tenure, firm line and actions rise 12px and fade in, staggered 0, 0.1, 0.18 and 0.28s over 1s. Everything else is state feedback: hovers, the nav underline, the tile zoom, the menu panel and the lightbox fade. All motion uses cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1). Under prefers-reduced-motion, all animation and transitions are removed and scrolling is instant.

dos: Do keep grounds white and warm stone, with navy only on bounded brand bands and buttons.
Do use gold only as 1px rules, underlines and small marks: Ridge Gold on light grounds, Soft Gold on navy and on photos.
Do set names and headings in Bodoni Moda at 400, and everything else in Archivo at normal width.
Do keep every corner square and every line 1px.
Do use underline-only fields with labels above, turning navy on focus and Brick on error.
Do use a navy focus ring on light grounds and soft gold on navy and on the hero.
Do state proof in sentences, using the reference figures as given.
Do keep a field's rest-state underline at 3:1 or better against its ground.
donts: Don't set gold text on white, or use gold as a fill.
Don't put eyebrow or kicker labels above headings.
Don't build stats or metric rows.
Don't run any photo full-bleed except the hero, and don't upscale gallery sources past 1024px.
Don't add rounded corners, boxed form fields (except the composed-message textarea), hard or offset shadows, or framed photos.
Don't add a second authored animation or scroll-triggered reveals, and don't leave anything moving under reduced motion.
Don't reintroduce themed or costume materials or dark full-page grounds.
